name: Nagzz21
description: Nagzz21, also known in VRChat as Joey Bagels, is a YouTuber and Twitch streamer who became one of the platform's most popular creators through episodic VRChat adventure videos featuring a recurring cast of friends. His original YouTube episodes ran for several seasons before he shifted toward livestreaming a variety of games on Twitch. He has also organized charity livestream events with the VRChat community.
